answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The copper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jade. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tundra of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
